suggestions.label: Read my website into the brain
suggestions.prompt: Read my whole website into the brain with the brain skill (tt-crawl pages, then tt-crawl docs), tell me how many pages you read and found, then distill it in passes by section into brain/ following brain/SCHEMA.md. Finish with what went in and the questions only I can answer. My site is

suggestions.label: Extract my brand
suggestions.prompt: Extract my brand from my site in raw/site (crawl it first with the brain skill if it is not there) into brand/ with the brand skill: positioning, voice with quoted examples, audience, visual identity (colours as hex, fonts, the logo files, the imagery notes from my real photos), do and don't, and the best photos in brand/images. Cite the raw page for every claim, mark anything you inferred as a question for me, and update brain/overview.md.

suggestions.label: Collect the facts about my company
suggestions.prompt: Collect the facts about my company from my site in raw/site (crawl it first with the brain skill if it is not there) into public/ with the brand skill: the business details, each service with its prices where stated, locations and service area, hours, the team, FAQs, policies, and real reviews as proof. Cite the raw page for every fact, never fill a gap from general knowledge, update brain/overview.md and brain/index.md, and end with the facts you could not find so I can give them to you.

suggestions.label: Read the documents linked from my site
suggestions.prompt: Fetch the documents my website links to (price lists, brochures, menus, forms) with tt-crawl docs, tell me what you found and what could not be read, then fold their facts into the notes in brain/ with citations.

suggestions.label: Add documents to the brain
suggestions.prompt: I have documents to add to the brain. Convert them into raw/docs with the brain skill, then fold their facts into the existing notes in brain/ rather than making duplicates, citing each document. The documents are

suggestions.label: What does the brain know?
suggestions.prompt: Give me a tour of what the brain knows so far: the overview in a few lines, the notes by folder, the sources they came from, any conflicts or open questions in brain/log.md, and the three biggest gaps you would fill next.

suggestions.label: Import my WordPress content
suggestions.prompt: My site runs on WordPress. Pull its pages and posts with `tt-crawl import --source wp` into its folder in raw/site (authors, dates, categories, full content), tell me what it found, then fold the facts into brain/ the usual way, citing the export. My site is

suggestions.label: Note what I just told you
suggestions.prompt: Record what I am about to tell you as a dated transcript in raw/transcripts (my words), then fold it into the right notes in brain/ with citations, and tell me what changed. Here it is:

suggestions.label: What changed on my site since last time
suggestions.prompt: Re-crawl my site with tt-crawl (into the same raw/site folder) and use the brain skill to tell me what changed since the last crawl: pages added, removed, or changed, facts that moved, and what in brain/ you updated as a result.
